FIRST TIME? START HERE.

You don’t need
to know the words.

01

Wear what you own.

Suits, jeans, shorts. Come in whatever feels like you.

02

Take your time.

Music, a message and room for conversation. Around seventy minutes altogether.

03

Bring your family.

Kids can stay with you. Ask the team about current children’s activities and check-in arrangements.

04

Stay anonymous.

No standing up, visitor badges or unexpected introductions. You choose how to join in.

WHAT WE BELIEVE

Grace is not
a reward.

Jesus is the centre, not our politics or preferences.

Doubt is not the opposite of faith. Bring your questions.

Everyone is welcome, exactly as they are.

Grace is not earned. It is not a prize for behaving well.
